metal.label: Metal / Metallic alloys
metal.environment: Stable humidity, low pollutants, controlled handling.
tasks: Check relative humidity and visible corrosion every 6 months.
Avoid direct handling without gloves.
Keep away from abrupt temperature and humidity changes.
Record any green, orange, black or powdery corrosion spots.

wood.label: Wood
wood.environment: Moderate humidity, good ventilation, no direct sun.
tasks: Inspect for mold, cracks, warping and insect activity every 4 months.
Avoid damp storage and direct sunlight.
Check joints and fragile carved areas before moving.
Document odor, stains or powder residue.

paper.label: Paper / Books / Documents
paper.environment: Dry, shaded, clean storage with minimal light exposure.
tasks: Check acidity, tears, stains, insects and deformation every 6 months.
Keep away from intense light and moisture.
Use supports when opening fragile books.
Avoid pressure marks from clips, rubber bands and adhesive tapes.

textile.label: Textile
textile.environment: Low light, clean support, pest monitoring.
tasks: Inspect for insects, fading, tears and folds every 3 months.
Avoid hanging fragile textiles without structural support.
Keep in breathable, clean storage.
Document color fading and fiber loss.

ceramic.label: Ceramic / Glass / Stone
ceramic.environment: Stable support, protected from impact and vibration.
tasks: Inspect cracks, old repairs, chips and unstable fragments once a year.
Avoid vibration and crowded shelves.
Use padded supports when moving.
Photograph any new fracture line.

default.label: General object
default.environment: Stable environment, clean storage, controlled handling.
tasks: Review condition every 6 months.
Update conservation notes after each inspection.
Check storage location and handling risks.
Add photographs when condition changes.
